newsitem.title: THAILAND: Buddha statue collapse kills three in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Buddha statue collapse kills three in Thailand.

text.p: An unfinished statue of Buddha collapsed in northern Thailand, killing three Thais and injuring seven others, police said on Thursday.

The 24 metre (80 ft) Buddha, being built at Nongpayon temple in Phitsanulok province about 500 km (300 miles) north of Bangkok, collapsed late on Wednesday as 10 workers were working on the top part of it, police said.
Police are investigating the cause of accident.
Ninety percent of Thailand's 60 million people are Buddhist.
